acceptedKnownIssue.behavior: An unresolved Ask to Buy request may leave the Remove Ads button available again after restarting the app.
acceptedKnownIssue.scope: Only this pending-button-after-restart behavior is accepted. No purchase-safety requirement is waived.

mandatoryPurchaseSafety: Only verified Apple current entitlement grants Remove Ads
Normal completed priced-product Apple Sandbox purchase grants ownership
Ownership survives restart and successful Restore
Already-owned users are not charged for the same non-consumable again
Finalization and recovery do not lose a paid entitlement
Deferred, failed and cancelled transactions never fabricate ownership
Reliable Restore Purchases recovery remains available

approvedProductionAdPolicy.audience: General Audience; adults and teenagers may play
approvedProductionAdPolicy.underAgeRequirement: Apply appropriate protections; do not classify everyone as children or assume everyone is 18+.
approvedProductionAdPolicy.supersededAgeBandPolicy2026_10_24: Under 13, 13-17, 18+, prefer not to answer; no Google requests for under-18/unspecified players, free eligible Hints, IAP/Restore available to all; no birth date; revisable in Settings
